[Hebrew lemma] Chal. & Syr. Grave, durum esse, gravari, aggravare: pretiosum esse vel videri, pretiose æstimari, honorari: & actived honorare, honore afficere. Pabel [Hebrew] In pretio habere, honorare, honore afficere, honorem exhibere: Item grave esse, Aggravare, obdurare, indurare. Ithpah. [Hebrew], Honorari, honore affici, glorificari: Item grave esse, aggravari, ingravescere. Ex Aph. Praet. [Syriac] Aggravârunt, Act. 28. 27.
[Hebrew lemma] Ch. & Syr. Honoratus, honorabilis, pretiosus, carus: Item Gravis, grave, difficile. Fœm. [Syriac lemma] Grave, difficile, pretiosum. Plur. [Hebrew] Fœm. [Hebrew].
[Syriac lemma] Syr. Onus, pondus, Gal. 6. 2. Plur. [Syriac lemma]
